title: October 2026 St. Augagama Firing
commitment: Fri-Tue loading/firing, unload Sat 10/24/26; stoking crew shift (8 hrs) required for $30–$50/cu ft options
cost_text: $30/cubic foot (includes wood splitting + 8-hr stoking crew shift); $50/cubic foot (8-hr stoking crew shift, no splitting); $80/cubic foot (no crew duties)
pay_text: Kiln space fees $30–$80 per cubic foot; crew labor required for lower-cost options
how_to_join: Register on the kiln space registration page
summary: The St. Augagama wood-fired anagama kiln in Saint Augustine fires October 10–15, 2026. Registration offers three pricing tiers ($30–$80/cu ft) based on labor contribution; all participants must bring bisqued ware and help with crew duties except at the highest tier. This firing is sold out.
evidence_sentence: The registration page states the kiln fires October 10–15, 2026, with pricing and labor options, and notes the firing is sold out.
